title: Krylov Method for the Generalized (Vector) Minimal Polynomial

insights: vecAnnSet I_v = {p | p(M)·v = 0} is an ideal (closed under mult by K[X]), not just subgroup
μ_M ∈ I_v always (from Cayley-Hamilton), so μ_{M,v} | μ_M — key divisibility
Degree bound: deg(μ_{M,v}) ≤ deg(μ_M) ≤ n, justifying Krylov termination in ≤ n steps
Proof uses minpoly.aeval K M for the matrix zero and Matrix.natDegree_charpoly for degree

minpoly_mem_vecAnnSet: μ_M ∈ I_v for all vectors v
vec_ann_poly_of_deg_le_dim: annihilating polynomial of degree ≤ n exists
krylov_zero_combo_at_minpoly: Krylov combo from μ_M is the zero vector
